notes:
Inbound self-serve signup Feb 12 -> spun up sandbox. Initial POC goal: replace rule-based responses in support chat with streaming assistant + tool-calling for ticket triage. Using Node SDK and browser client, connecting to Hosted API in us-east-1. Short timeline:
- 2026-02-12: user signed up, created API key, started simple chat test.
- 2026-02-15: AE (Jordan) intro email; offered walkthrough.
- 2026-02-20: 45m call w/ SE (Priya) - demo streaming + function call examples. Customer reported JSON mode returning broken payloads mid-stream. Fireflies ff_20260220_44112 has call audio.
- 2026-03-01: Customer opened Jira INF-5427 (malformed JSON when streaming + tools). Provided repro with small convo and function schema.
- 2026-03-04: Discovered they are parsing streaming chunks incrementally in browser; chunk boundaries can split JSON object -> their parser fails. They asked for guidance on using json-mode vs function schemas.
- 2026-03-08: Live debug w/ SE - reproduced issue when using legacy Node SDK chunking; patch candidate: switch to line-delimited JSON framing or use SDK helper that reassembles events. Ticket INF-5489 created for SDK fix. Call notes: "We need deterministic JSON or fallback to plain text - our frontend cannot tolerate parse errors" (quote from CTO, Mira Patel).
- Current: customer experimenting with workaround (buffer until final chunk then parse) but sees 300-500ms extra latency which breaks UX.

Use-case details / requirements: streaming chat + tool-calling to run search ranker and create tickets. Target latency p95 for responses under 600ms, throughput moderate (peak 5-10 rps during morning window). Cost sensitivity: high — small startup, wants predictable per-call pricing. Model preference: smaller, fast open models with function-calling support; willing to test Redwood curated models.

Open items / blockers: need clear client-side examples for robust streaming JSON assembly; confirm SDK release timeline for chunk reassembly helper; provide canonical function schema recommendations (snake_case vs camelCase param names) to avoid mismatch; advise on graceful fallback when parser fails.

Requested deliverables: quick debugging session, sample client helper (JS) that reassembles stream events, a short doc in Drive with recommended function schema patterns, and a note on how Hosted API signals end-of-stream / function call events.

Internal notes: low ARR likely but high reference value if we help unblock quickly. Recommend quick-win: ship small SDK patch and attach example to thread-1782938475. Follow-up goal: convert to paying within 30-60 days after stable POC.
